features.decide: Ask a yes/no question in an automation
features.answer_check: Check the knowledge base before answering

automation.ai_triage_hint: Sets tags, priority, sentiment and language from the conversation.
automation.ai_decide_placeholder: Is the customer at risk of churning?
automation.ai_decide_hint: Ollie answers with a probability of yes. Every question in one run is asked together.

settings.title: AI
settings.description: Drafts, summaries, translation and triage for your team. Customer content goes only to the configured provider and is never used for training.
settings.read_only: Only admins can change these settings.
settings.enabled_hint: Turns every AI feature on or off for everyone. Nothing is sent to the provider while it's off.
settings.assistant_section_hint: {{name}} is the assistant in the header. It works with each teammate's own permissions.
settings.assistant_hint: Answers questions about the queue, finds tickets and prepares changes. Nothing changes until the teammate approves it. Each message uses credits.
settings.automatic_hint: These run without anyone asking, and use credits each time.
settings.auto_triage_hint: Suggests tags, priority, sentiment and language on every new ticket, before your automations run.
settings.auto_summarize_hint: Refreshes the summary on tickets with five or more messages.
settings.widget_answers: Answer chats from the knowledge base
settings.widget_answers_hint: Answers come only from published articles, are labelled as AI, and always offer a Talk to a person button. When no article fits, the chat goes straight to your team.
settings.tone_hint: Applied to drafted replies. Agents can still ask for a different tone each time.
settings.custom_tone_placeholder: Warm and direct, like a helpful colleague
settings.reply_language_hint: Drafts can follow the customer's language or always use your workspace's.
settings.instructions_hint: Extra guidance for every draft: product names, policies, things to avoid.
settings.instructions_placeholder: Call the product Fieldnote, never Field Note. Offer a refund only for charges in the last 30 days.
settings.models_hint: The default model writes drafts and answers; the fast one handles triage and short tasks.
settings.embeddings_on: Semantic search finds related tickets and articles by meaning.
settings.embeddings_off: No embeddings provider, so search matches keywords.
settings.costs_hint: Credits are spent only when a call succeeds.
settings.not_configured: AI isn't set up on this instance
settings.not_configured_hint: Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, or point OPENAI_BASE_URL at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (including a local model), then restart opendesk.

kb_draft.title: Draft an article from tickets
kb_draft.description: Pick the conversations that answer the question, or describe the topic. The draft fills the editor; nothing is published until you do.
kb_draft.topic_placeholder: Resetting SSO when the identity provider rotates its certificate
kb_draft.need_input: Choose a ticket or describe a topic.
kb_draft.replace_body: The draft replaces the current title, excerpt and body. You can still discard before saving.
kb_draft.done: Draft ready. Review it before publishing.
kb_draft.step_find: Finding what the answers have in common

palette.ask_hint: Search by meaning across tickets and articles
palette.placeholder: Ask anything, like customers who were charged twice
palette.empty: Nothing related yet. Try describing the problem in other words.
palette.start: Describe what you're looking for in plain words.
palette.error: Couldn't search right now. Try again in a moment.
